teapot.name: Teapot (Sagittarius asterism)
teapot.description: The Teapot is an asterism in Sagittarius pointing at the galactic core. The 8 main stars used as search centres.
teapot.note: Coordinates for Kaus Borealis/Media/Australis, Ascella, Nunki, Terebellum refreshed from live EDSM 2026-10-05 ('Terebellum' resolves; '59 Sagittarii' does not). Sphere searches resolve via 'edsm' names regardless. Phi Sagittarii/Alnasl remain approximate: EDSM returns no entry for 'Phi Sagittarii', 'Gamma Sagittarii' or 'Alnasl' as of 2026-10-05.
